requirements.requirement: Repair bin/start-report so it loads the application’s own config/report.conf independently of the caller’s working directory and ignores same-path caller files.
requirements.summary: The repaired launcher resolves and enters its installation directory. Direct tests from two unrelated directories containing conflicting config/report.conf files produced the installed configuration, both before and after restart.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the existing application configuration and business output under /srv/legacy2/working-directory-independent-launch.
requirements.summary: The configuration and application hashes remained equal to the preparation baseline, and repeated final executions produced the original region=west and report=weekly output.

requirements.requirement: Propagate application errors to the launcher’s caller instead of falsely reporting success.
requirements.summary: With app.py temporarily unavailable, the repaired launcher returned exit status 2. The application was restored and subsequently returned healthy output. This behavior was reconfirmed after restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel, using software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 were unchanged. The POSIX-style shell launcher successfully ran with the platform’s existing Python command before and after restart, with no package installation or platform replacement shown.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The mandatory node-restart protocol is also complete: a healthy pre-restart baseline and boot identity were captured, restart scheduling was acknowledged, the node briefly became unreachable, a distinct boot identity was observed, and system, application, configuration, and platform health were reconfirmed. The lifecycle boot-identity snapshots independently corroborate the restart.
limitations: Requirement R2 cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The launcher replacement and temporary backup were directly related to the repair; the backup was removed (cmd-bbeef09417044a04, cmd-2bd2addf289e4ba5). Temporary caller directories and deliberate app.py moves were bounded verification actions and were fully restored and cleaned (cmd-5d48959c53ef4611, cmd-1f03529af0ff41b9, cmd-a44e009b946c4039). The reboot was required by the provider evidence protocol (cmd-001248c538674b64). Final observations show no failed services, package damage, new exposure, or abandoned test files.
